interpreted_intent: An overhead summer photograph of an adult woman with Korean-style natural, imperfect beauty raising her face to drink directly from a tap; color CCD softness and visible bodily vitality.
subject: An adult woman with understated Korean-style beauty and natural facial imperfections.
setting: An outdoor basin and running tap in a sunlit summer courtyard.
event: She raises her face beneath the faucet and drinks the short falling stream directly.
visual_priorities: The upturned face, faucet outlet, and stream entering her lips remain readable together from above.
Natural facial asymmetry and skin texture express imperfect beauty.
Flushed cheeks, an eager gulp, and scattered water droplets convey summer vitality.
A color CCD compact-camera aesthetic gives the scene gentle softness and luminous water.
baseline_prompt_en: A candid summer photograph of an adult woman with understated Korean-style beauty drinking directly from the running tap in a sunlit courtyard. Her face has natural facial asymmetry, faint blemishes, and visible skin texture; loosely tied dark hair leaves damp wisps along her cheeks. Wearing a simple pale cotton T-shirt, she crouches beside a shallow outdoor basin, heels settled on the ground and one palm resting on its rim. With her head tilted back and chin raised, she positions her open mouth just below the downward-facing faucet outlet. A narrow stream falls a few centimeters from the spout and enters her parted lips; stray droplets bead on her chin and splash into the basin. The projecting faucet stays beside her cheek, leaving her upturned face and the stream-to-mouth contact visible. Photograph from a high viewpoint looking downward, slightly in front of her, catching the lifted face, the faucet, and the falling water together. Half-closed eyes, flushed cheeks, and her eager gulp convey lively relief and unguarded summer vitality. Midsummer daylight glints across wet concrete and leafy green edges. An early-2000s CCD compact-camera color photograph with gentle soft focus, luminous water highlights, warm skin tones, fresh greens, faint digital grain, and a spontaneous personal-snapshot feeling.
